scope: Bounded candidate join of positive LG/SKY/Pantech-Curitel/VK workbook rows and the relevant completed GNEX Zone cards against five already captured public brand indexes. Observations, directories, listing bytes and locally hashed basename candidates are separate evidence levels.

normalization.purpose: Candidate directory search only, never an alias or firmware-variant assertion.
steps: Take text before the first parenthesis for the candidate search key only.
Strip a leading LG or SKY label, case-fold to uppercase, remove punctuation and spacing.
Match the resulting full key only within allowed manufacturer buckets; keep original labels and all source rows separately.
Do not trim model suffixes C, M, V, Dv, W or merge PG/PH, SK/IM, carrier variants or Upgrade names.
normalization.importantLimit: An IM-5000 Worldcup/WI-TOP row may lead to the base IM-5000 directory. That does not establish that any archive in it covers the indicated variant.
